but when I sleep with my fathers, you shall carry me out of Egypt, and bury me in their burying place.” Joseph said, “I…
for his sons carried him into the land of Canaan, and buried him in the cave of the field of Machpelah, which Abraham…

people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

people.name: Isaac
people.line: Son of Abraham; father of Jacob and Esau.

people.name: Leah
people.line: Wife of Jacob; mother of six sons and Dinah

people.name: Rebekah
people.line: Wife of Isaac; mother of Jacob and Esau

people.name: Sarah
people.line: Wife of Abraham; mother of Isaac

translations.web: There they buried Abraham and Sarah, his wife. There they buried Isaac and Rebekah, his wife, and there I buried Leah:
translations.bsb: There Abraham and his wife Sarah are buried, there Isaac and his wife Rebekah are buried, and there I buried Leah.
translations.kjv: There they buried Abraham and Sarah his wife; there they buried Isaac and Rebekah his wife; and there I buried Leah.
